name: bash
description: Run a shell command; long calls auto-background. Output: 2000 lines/50 KiB; read full logs with read. Monitor batches cost turns: print state changes, not heartbeats; identical lines are suppressed. For reminders, use a monitored sleep loop with dated output; for goals, print only while unmet. Stop unneeded process groups with kill -- -<pgid>. At the live-shell limit, wait, read logs or stop a group; don't launch polling shells.

monitor.description: Stream progress batches; set at launch.

background.description: Return immediately with a shell id.

inactivityReminderSeconds.description: No-output reminder delay in seconds (default 1800); 0 disables.

name: wait
description: Wait for background shells; wait/notice intervals: 5m, 10m, 30m, 1h, 3h, then 6h.
